description: Build a caption track from pre-timed lines (e.g. derived from transcribe_clip's word timings). mode "line-sync" (default) creates one text layer per line, each shown only during its [startFrame, endFrame) window via hold-eased opacity keyframes — the active-line karaoke read; mode "static" makes a single layer with all lines joined. `style` picks a preset look. Lines default to a lower-third band. The caption layers are always wrapped in a "captions" group so they don't clutter the layers list. Returns the created text element ids plus `groupElementId` (the captions group).

clip_element_id.description: Optional "video.<id>" to WELD the caption lines to (line-sync mode). When set, each line's startFrame/endFrame are treated as its window in the clip's OWN source timeline and the on-timeline position is derived live from the clip's trim — so trimming or sliding the clip retimes/clips the captions, exactly like the clip's welded audio. Omit for fixed project-frame captions.

height.description: Band height. Default ~16% of canvas height.

lines.description: Caption lines in order. Each: { text, startFrame, endFrame } — frames are 0-indexed at 30fps.

clip_element_id.description: Optional per-line weld clip ("video.<id>"), overriding the top-level clip_element_id. Routes THIS line onto a specific lane clip — used to spread one montage's lines across the several clips that a single source was split into, so each line rides the clip that shows its words.

endFrame.description: Project frame the line disappears (defaults to startFrame + 30).

mode.description: "line-sync" (default): one timed layer per line. "static": one layer with all lines.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.

width.description: Band width. Default ~86% of canvas width.

x.description: Caption band centre x. Default canvas centre.

y.description: Caption band centre y. Default lower third (~80% of height).
